hub.tagline: Partition the grid into rectangles — each one's area must match the clue it covers.

all.title: Draw a rectangle around each clue
all.desc: Drag from one cell to another to draw a rectangle. Every rectangle must cover exactly one numbered clue.

all.title: The rectangle's area must match the number
all.desc: A rectangle's cell count (rows x cols) has to equal the clue it covers -- get it wrong and it's flagged in red until you resize it.

all.title: Tap a rectangle to remove it — cover every cell to win
all.desc: Tap anywhere inside a placed rectangle to delete it and try again. The board is solved once every cell belongs to exactly one correctly-sized rectangle.

game.hintFailToast: Every clue is already correctly filled in.
game.winSubtitle: Every clue's rectangle fits — next board unlocked.
